notes: Director's cut for U1-E7 'The Valladolid Debate' (script v3, Maya+Marcus debate format). 14 scenes. Each scene carries a 'turns' [start, end] partition of the 48 TTS segments (t00..t47, including the two 5s self-test silences) — run refit_durations.py against the rendered turns dir to replace the estimated duration_sec values with measured sums (the mix is a straight concat, so this is exact). Visual grammar: KeywordPops on the exam terms; ImageSlides with period engravings for the Short Account, the Black Legend irony, and the Potosí mines; dimmed Taos Pueblo behind Las Casas's 'ordered peoples'; HighlightSlide for the never-printed Democrates; StepsSlide recap; DisplayHeadline Q&A; QuoteSlide closing tagline. Debate-attribution rule: every beat stating a debatable position names its claimant (LAS CASAS / SEPULVEDA) in the text itself. No blank backgrounds. Eyes-closed-safe.

params.headline: BOX TWO · SEPULVEDA'S CASE
params.sub: The empire's lawyer — who never crossed the Atlantic

overlays.text: Reporting the argument — not endorsing it

points: **SEPULVEDA (via Aristotle)** — some peoples are slaves by nature, born to be ruled
**SEPULVEDA** — the Native peoples fit the description: 'homunculi,' little men, scarcely a trace of humanity

params.text: Democrates alter was ==never printed in Spain== during Sepulveda's lifetime — Las Casas helped make sure of that. But the argument ==circulated anyway==: the conquistadors bought it, and out in the colonies it was the excuse everyone already wanted.

points: **SEPULVEDA** — idolatry and human sacrifice offended natural law; a war that ended them was mercy, not cruelty
**SEPULVEDA** — conquest brings the true faith and real law to people who can't govern themselves: order through conquest
**LAS CASAS'S ANSWER** — the faith had to be offered, never forced; force only made fake Christians

params.headline: The verdict that wasn't
params.sub: 1550 into 1551 — the judges scattered without issuing a ruling

params.caption: The encomienda survived, the mines kept running — but the question survived: the seed of natural-rights language
params.title: On the ground, almost nothing changed

steps: **LAS CASAS'S CASE** — rational souls, capable of faith and self-government. The Short Account, written 1542. And the irony: his book became Black Legend fuel.
**SEPULVEDA'S CASE** — Aristotle's natural slaves (his claim); Democrates alter never printed in Spain; just war: end idolatry, bring order.
**THE VERDICT THAT WASN'T** — 1550 into 1551, no ruling, both sides claimed victory. On the ground almost nothing changed — but the question survived.
